results.explanation: At the declared POST /process/text boundary, the principal is the verified user supplied by the dependency. When that caller supplies a collection name, the handler binds that exact name as the target and requests write access validation before constructing and submitting the caller-supplied content to the vector-database save function. The validator delegates to the shared collection policy and raises HTTP 403 when the requested name is not returned as allowed. For a non-admin generic collection name that identifies an existing knowledge base, the shared path adds the name only when Knowledges.check_access_by_user_id succeeds with permission='write'; the permissive fallback applies only when no such knowledge base exists. Under the stated premise that the selected collection exists and the verified non-admin is neither its owner nor explicitly write-granted, the accepted owner-or-write-grant policy makes that write check fail, so the requested name remains denied and the 403 occurs before the vector write sink. Thus the caller-selected text cannot be written to that existing caller-selected knowledge-base collection through this entry in the stated scenario.

entry.statement: The declared entry is POST /process/text, and its caller principal is bound through the verified-user dependency.

binding.statement: The handler binds the target to the supplied collection name and, when one is supplied, invokes collection access validation with access_type='write'.
The supplied text becomes document content, and the verified user's identifier is recorded as its creator.

citations.quote:
async def _validate_collection_access(collection_names: list[str], user, access_type: str = 'read') -> None:
    """
    Raise 403 if the user lacks access to any of the requested collections.
    Delegates to the shared filter_accessible_collections utility so the
    access rules stay in one place.
    """
    requested = set(collection_names)
    allowed = await filter_accessible_collections(requested, user, access_type=access_type)
    denied = requested - allowed
    if denied:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail=ERROR_MESSAGES.ACCESS_PROHIBITED,
        )

control.statement: For a generic collection name, the shared policy adds it when the knowledge-base access check succeeds using the requested access type; the alternative allowance applies only if no knowledge base with that name exists.

effect.statement: The protected effect is submission of the constructed document and selected collection name to save_docs_to_vector_db, which occurs after collection validation.
